text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — IvyChip preview NDA is signed by both sides. We need to lock the early access playbook: benchmarks, telemetry contract, marketplace packaging, and joint announcement timing. Can folks call out owners for each? :raised_hands:

Ozgur: Nice. For benches — plan to run a small MLPerf-inference subset + 3 internal realism workloads (chat 2k, rerank, embeddings). Need to decide target SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and whether partner firmware will be in the loop.

Ravi: Re: NDA — legal confirms telemetry allowed but we must strip any customer identifiers. Need the telemetry schema and storage location. Also: who will own the NDA redline if partner requests changes? @legal-team FYI.

Sophie: From marketing: we should lock an embargo window before any marketplace listing. Suggest tentative announce embargo: 2024-08-15; joint blog + partner quote + webinar ~2 weeks after. Also need logo/co-branding guidelines from partner.

devrel-bot: Created shared folder and checklist: https://drive.redwood-inference/ivy-eap — has initial bench templates, onboarding checklist, and contact list. (automated)

Maya: Proposal to keep it minimal for EAP:
- Bench plan: mlperf-lite + chat2k + embed-100k (owner: Ozgur)
- Telemetry schema: small JSON bundle with anonymized traces (owner: Ravi to confirm legal)
- Marketplace packaging: docker + terraform module + listing draft (owner: Sophie)
- SI integration tests: runtime smoke + perf replay (owner: Maya)

Ozgur: Perf knobs: please capture p50/p95/p99 latency and token/s throughput. Also capture kernel-level counters if partner can expose them. Example bench run we’ll use locally:
```bash
run_bench --model ivy-1b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --profile perf --out ./results/ivy.json
```

Ravi: I’ll request a redline from legal and confirm telemetry fields we can collect. ETA EOD today for the initial redline. If partner wants additional telemetry we’ll require an addendum.

Sophie: OK — marketing will draft the co-marketing brief and a marketplace listing skeleton by Mon. Can we get final embargo agreement + partner logo rights by next Thu so we can lock dates? :calendar:

Maya: Owners confirmed. Next steps:
- Ozgur to push bench repo + perf targets (due Wed)
- Ravi to post legal redline (EOD)
- Sophie to send marketplace draft (Mon)
- I’ll schedule a partner sync for Thu 9am PT to walk through playbook

Ozgur: I’ll also add lightweight telemetry adapter to bench harness so we can toggle on/off partner counters.

Ravi: Added legal lead: Priya (cc). Priya, please watch for the redline request.

Sophie: Added webinar draft to the drive. Also attaching suggested co-branded slide template in the folder.

Maya: Thanks all — syncing Thu. If anything blocks earlier, drop in this thread or DM. :rocket:
